evidence: Manual-backed syntax and authored offline implementation tests; no native controller execution

sources.topic: Global handlers, multiple WHEN clauses and enable/disable/purge
Registers, paths, queues, task procedures, file attributes and robot-model operations

implementation.registers_ports_variables: Explicit in-memory banks, static variable paths and host-bound foreign storage; checked disjoint outputs; no hardware acquisition
implementation.files: Byte-backed MemoryFiles, bounded cursors and checked scalar transfers; little-endian binary fields and ASCII text; no operating-system path access
implementation.collections: Typed one-based PATH nodes/header and independent copies; initialized fixed-capacity FIFO queues tied to one backing array
implementation.control: Cooperative generator frames, first matching WHEN clause, one-shot handlers with explicit rearm, checkpoint timers and explicit callback/task registries
implementation.geometry: Checked frame math with external metadata propagation; explicit proper-rotation MIRROR convention; kinematic and reachability adapters require supplied models

portable_choices.status_codes: Register/path/variable/queue status conventions documented in offline-services.md; they do not assert a native alarm mapping
portable_choices.binary: Little endian; IEEE host struct REAL encoding at 4 or 8 bytes; portable ATR_IA identifier 1
portable_choices.stop: Terminal offline task stop; native KAREL STOP/RESUME motion behavior is outside this implementation
portable_choices.extended_axes: Zero-fill on widening, drop on narrowing; preserve on inverse/MIRROR, rightmost extended operand on colon, origin metadata on FRAME
portable_choices.mirror_orientation: Reflect about frame XZ, then reverse local Y to retain a proper rotation
portable_choices.queue: Capacity equals backing-array length, monotonically increasing sequence IDs, zero-filled unused backing slots
